description: This file defines a Python class `LLMLogObserver` that observes and logs interactions with a Large Language Model (LLM), filtering and recording specific frame events related to LLM responses, function calls, and context frames. It is part of a larger project involving frame processing and LLM service interactions.

classes.name: LLMLogObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs various LLM frame activities, such as start/end responses, generated text, function calls, and context frames, for monitoring LLM interactions within the system.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles the event when a new frame is pushed. It logs different types of LLM-related frames based on their class and the direction of data flow.
